svg.title: Slide5 Predict2
svg.desc: Plot: Second prediction step of Monte Carlo localization on a 10 by 10 meter map with landmarks at (2,8), (8,8) and (8,2). Each particle is moved forward along a noisy arc, leaving gray trails. The particles split into a main cluster near (3.8, 4), matching the true robot pose at the end of a short dark orange arc, and a second cluster near (3.4, 5.8), plus a few strays. The estimated mean pose, near (3.9, 4.7), lies between the clusters, slightly off the true pose.
